verdict.rationale: Preventing customer data from being used for AI model training is a fair privacy-posture question for an AI meeting-notes SaaS like Fathom. Nothing in the evidence pack covers a training opt-out, a no-training policy, or data-use controls. The pack is limited to API, webhooks, SDKs, MCP, and pricing features, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
